results.title: Perspective Chapter: Primary Education in Western China after ...
results.content: In light of this, this study focuses on the theme “An Analysis of the Current Situation of Primary Education in Western China and the Optimization of Home-School-Community Collaboration Mechanisms in the Post-Pandemic Era.” Based on survey data collected from parents and teachers, this study systematically analyzes the post-pandemic changes in family education structure, teacher professional status, and the school-community support system. Specifically, the chapter unfolds its investigation in four aspects: first, it analyzes the post-pandemic changes in household educational investment, parental expectations, and child development support; second, it explores the sources of stress and occupational changes encountered by teachers during the pedagogical adaptation process; third, it evaluates the current interaction between schools and communities in supporting educational resources; and finally, it proposes forward-looking optimization paths and policy recommendations for improving home-school-community collaboration, aimed at promoting a more balanced and high-quality development of primary education.
